出版者的话

古希腊圣哲亚里士多德曾说：“任何人都会生气，这没什么难的，但若要适时适所地以适当方式对适当对象恰如其分地生气，可就难上加难了。”而我们现在讲的情绪管理指的就是要适时适所地对适当对象恰如其分地表达情绪。

现实生活中，人们越来越多地认识到情绪管理能力的重要性，因为这方面能力出众的人往往在各个领域都游刃有余；相反，此项能力差的人，虽然可能很聪明，但做起事来往往很吃力。

情绪管理能力虽部分得益于先天因素，但归根结底还得靠后天的学习和培养，而幼儿时期是情绪管理能力培养的黄金时期。一个人在幼儿时期所获得的情绪经验和习惯会在大脑中形成永久的神经联结，对其身心发展影响很长远。

当前，亲子共读情绪管理类图画书这种情绪管理能力培养方式已被广泛认可。优质的图画书好比幸福的种子，通过父母的声音飞进孩子的耳朵里，植根在孩子的心底，施以阳光、雨露就能生根、发芽。

这套有趣的动物图画故事书温情脉脉，每一本都是有针对性地就孩子的某一种情绪话题展开，描绘孩子的心路历程，揭示其走出情绪困扰并解决问题的过程。每一本书都附有幼教专家精心撰写的导读，可作为家长亲子共读时的参考。

让我们在这套书的陪伴下，去享受一段美妙的亲子阅读之旅吧！

page_text_en:
Publisher's Note

The ancient Greek philosopher Aristotle once said: 'Everyone gets angry, and that's not difficult. But to be angry at the right time, in the right place, in the right way, with the right person, and to the right degree—that's difficult indeed.' What we now call emotional management is precisely about expressing emotions appropriately, at the right time and place, toward the right person, and to the right degree.

In real life, people are increasingly recognizing the importance of emotional management skills, because those who excel in this area often thrive in various fields; conversely, those who lack this skill, although possibly very intelligent, often struggle in their endeavors.

While emotional management skills may partly stem from innate factors, they ultimately depend on learning and cultivation in later life. Early childhood is the golden period for developing emotional management skills. The emotional experiences and habits formed during this period create permanent neural connections in the brain, profoundly influencing a child's physical and mental development.

Currently, the practice of parent-child reading of emotional management picture books is widely recognized as an effective way to cultivate emotional skills. High-quality picture books are like seeds of happiness, carried into children's ears by parents' voices, taking root in their hearts, and with sunlight and rain, they can grow and flourish.

This series of heartwarming animal picture storybooks is designed to address specific emotional topics for children, illustrating their emotional journeys and revealing how they overcome emotional challenges and solve problems. Each book includes a carefully written guide by early childhood education experts, serving as a reference for parents during shared reading.

Let us enjoy a wonderful parent-child reading journey together with this series!

Teacher Says to You
There's a 'Little Prince' in Every Family
Every family has had, or currently has, a 'Little Prince'.
Adults often wonder: why, even with the most abundant material conditions, the best teachers, and the most comfortable environment, is the 'Little Prince' still dissatisfied?
After reading this story, you'll understand that during a child's growth, they inevitably face the conflict between behavioral constraints and free will. Simply put, it's the contradiction between parents' expectations for their child's behavior and the child's own developing self-awareness. Let's analyze this story with a chart to make it clearer:
Adults' Actions/Thoughts
Lion King and Queen
Gently ruling the savanna
Every day, people send the Little Prince various gifts

Frustrated, angry, and gloomy
Doesn't follow instructions, goes off on his own
Throws things wildly, rebels against parents, runs away from home
Happy and free,
but also a little lonely

source_file: 不听话的狮子小王子（3-5 岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
从图示中我们可以看出，父母希望孩子成为自己心目中的样子，听父母的话。但孩子在已经掌握了一些基本的生活技能，如走路、写字、读书等后，便开始有了更清晰的“我”的概念，产生了“想做什么”与“不想做什么”的自主意识，进入了人生第一个反叛期。孩子的这种需求发展使我们很容易想到美国著名心理学家马斯洛的需要层次理论，如图：

在这个“金字塔”理论结构中，低层次的需要小王子的父母都给予了，但“自我实现的需要”却无法直接给予。整日困在皇宫里养尊处优，过腻了熟悉的生活，小王子肯定没有任何的成就感，所以一直在反叛，渴望离开皇宫去探险。

其实，父母所认为的最舒适、最优越的环境，对于孩子来讲可能并不一定是最合适的环境。让孩子依靠自己的求知欲和探索力去向前走，不包办一切，只提供适当有挑战的环境，以激发他的“正能量”，让他真正感受到实现心中所愿所带来的成就感——也许，这才是真正的爱！

（山东英才学院 张舒、胡志远）
page_text_en:
From the illustration, we can see that parents hope their children will become the kind of people they envision, and listen to their parents. However, after children have mastered some basic life skills, such as walking, writing, and reading, they begin to develop a clearer sense of "self," generating an autonomous awareness of "what I want to do" and "what I don't want to do," entering their first rebellious phase in life. This kind of developmental need reminds us of the famous American psychologist Maslow's hierarchy of needs theory, as shown in the diagram:

In this "pyramid" theory structure, the lower-level needs of the little prince have been met by his parents, but the need for "self-actualization" cannot be directly provided. Trapped in the palace, living in luxury and comfort, and tired of his familiar life, the little prince certainly has no sense of achievement, so he keeps rebelling and yearns to leave the palace to go on an adventure.

In fact, the most comfortable and superior environment that parents consider may not necessarily be the most suitable environment for children. Let children move forward relying on their own curiosity and exploratory drive, without doing everything for them. Instead, provide an appropriately challenging environment to stimulate their "positive energy," allowing them to truly feel the sense of achievement from realizing their inner desires—perhaps, this is true love!

(Shandong Yingcai University, Zhang Shu, Hu Zhiyuan)
summary_zh: 本页通过马斯洛需求层次理论解释了孩子进入叛逆期的心理原因，指出父母应提供有挑战的环境以激发孩子的成就感，而非一味包办，最后署名为山东英才学院张舒、胡志远。

无论在哪里都是这样，
小莱昂纳多谁的话都不听。
因为他是尊贵的王子，
所以谁都不敢惩罚他。
狮子国王和狮子王后太忙了，
也没有时间管教小王子，
所以他们就让侍者小青蛙来管管小王子莱昂纳多。
page_text_en:
No matter where he was, 
Leonardo never listened to anyone.
Because he was a noble prince,
no one dared to punish him.
The Lion King and Queen were too busy,
and had no time to discipline the young prince,
so they assigned the attendant frog to take care of Prince Leonardo.
summary_zh: 本页说明小狮子莱昂纳多因身份尊贵而无人敢管教，狮子国王和王后因忙碌无暇顾及，于是指派侍者小青蛙来管教他。画面中，小莱昂纳多站在三只穿着西装的小青蛙侍者中间，其中一只端着托盘，另两只似乎在对他说话或指挥。

“王子殿下，不好意思，打扰您了。

"Your Highness, sorry to disturb you.

既不听你们的，也不听任何人的！
不听，不听，就是不听！

"What are you croaking about?!
I don't understand a word!
But I know, I will never listen to anyone!
Not you, not anyone!
No, no, I won't listen!
Now disappear from here, that's my command!"
"But, but..." the frog servant stammered.
"No buts, I said, disappear now!" Leonardo roared.

一叠盘子、一个烛台、凳子、运动鞋……统统被他扔了出去。
接着，他狠狠地关上门，把自己反锁在房间里。

page_text_en:
Angry Leonardo started throwing things around,
stacks of plates, a candlestick, a stool, sneakers... all thrown out by him.
Then, he slammed the door shut and locked himself in the room.
After that, little Leonardo walked back and forth in the room, frowning,
and came up with a plan to rebel against his parents...

page_text_en:
Leonardo muttered to himself, whispering:
"Since things have come to this,
the best thing to do is run away from home.
I'll go very, very far, to a place where no one can find me.
Everyone will worry about me,
and I won't even call them!
Then, when I've had enough in the distance, I'll come back.
At that time, everyone will welcome me back with song and dance!"
summary_zh: 小狮子莱昂纳多在房间内自言自语，计划离家出走，幻想自己远走高飞后家人会如何欢迎他归来。画面中散落着礼物、玩具和糖果，显示房间已被弄得一团糟。

Actions speak louder than words!

"Ha ha, goodbye everyone, I'm off! The adventure is waiting for me ahead!"
summary_zh: 小狮子莱昂纳多准备好了行囊，带上他喜欢的物品，兴奋地出发去探险，告别家人，踏上旅程。

page_text_ocr_zh:
莱昂纳多悄悄逃出宫殿，逃出草原，
他的爸爸妈妈一点都没有察觉到。
他走啊走，走了好几个小时，
然后在一片空地前停下了。
他走累了，想歇一会儿。
这时的小莱昂纳多是多么快乐啊！
没有人再对他指手画脚，唠唠叨叨。
只是，他感到有一点点孤独……
page_text_en:
Leonardo quietly escaped from the palace, leaving the grassland behind.
His parents didn't notice at all.
He walked and walked, for several hours,
then stopped before an open field.
He was tired and wanted to rest for a while.
At this moment, little Leonardo was so happy!
No one was pointing fingers or nagging at him anymore.
But still, he felt a little bit lonely……
summary_zh: 小狮子莱昂纳多悄悄离开家，在草原上走了好几个小时后停在一片空地，虽然感到自由和快乐，但也开始感受到一丝孤独。

现在，天色渐渐变黑了，寒风越来越凛冽。

page_text_en:
Now, the sky was gradually turning dark, and the cold wind was becoming more severe.
Suddenly, a 'bang' rang out in Leonardo's ears!
One second later, a second sound, then a third, growing closer and closer.
"Help! Help! It's the可怕的 hunters shooting! They're getting closer and closer!
Dad, Mom, help!" Leonardo shouted as he ran.
summary_zh: 小狮子莱昂纳多在草原上奔跑，天色变黑，寒风凛冽，他听到猎人开枪的声音，惊恐地呼救，感到害怕和无助。

但是没有人听到小莱昂纳多的呼救声，因为他离家实在是太远了。
小狮子以最快的速度逃命，一边跑，一边后悔自己太任性，

突然，他听到了一声熟悉的狮吼，

But no one heard Leonardo's cry for help, because he was too far from home.
The little lion fled at top speed, running while regretting his own stubbornness,

Suddenly, he heard a familiar roar,
It was his dad, who had followed his tracks and brought many rescuers.

page_text_en:
Under the leadership of King and Queen Lion, 
the soldiers chased the hunters and drove them away. 
The animals won! Little Leonardo was rescued! 
The little lion felt especially ashamed of running away from home. He said: 
"I'm sorry. From today on, I won't be so stubborn anymore, 
I'll become the most well-behaved little prince." 
Everyone clapped for the little prince. Now, the celebration party begins!
summary_zh: 在狮子国王和王后的带领下，士兵们赶走了猎人，小狮子莱昂纳多获救后感到羞愧并承诺不再任性，大家为他鼓掌并开始庆祝晚会。
